answer: Each agent identity is minted only by locking a bonded stake in the protocol vault. The bond stays locked ninety days and is slashable in full if linked receipts prove one operator runs many identities. Reputation comes from countersigned work receipts, not registration, so a thousand fresh agents start at zero weight and win no jobs. An attacker pays a real, forfeitable asset per fake identity while an honest operator pays it once; any detected cluster burns as a single plume of slashed collateral. Cheap signups never reach the summit of the job queue; only bonded, proven agents do.
